changeSet.author: cold-storage-monitoring-audit

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE constraint_name = 'uk_freezer_reading_freezer_recorded_at' AND table_name = 'freezer_reading'

changeSet.comment: A retried poll (e.g. after a Modbus timeout that actually succeeded on the far side, or a duplicate scheduler trigger) could previously insert two freezer_reading rows for the same freezer at the same recorded_at timestamp. A unique constraint on (freezer_id, recorded_at) prevents this at the database level. Pre-existing duplicate rows (if any) are deduplicated first, keeping the lowest id, so the constraint can be added cleanly.
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM clinlims.freezer_reading fr USING clinlims.freezer_reading fr2 WHERE fr.freezer_id = fr2.freezer_id AND fr.recorded_at = fr2.recorded_at AND fr.id > fr2.id;
